name: Munkie All-Stars
summary:
# Hiya, munkies!

Munkie All-Stars is an online multiplayer VR party game taking you back through the 3 whole years of Munkie. You and your friends can do a multitude of fun things:

# 👹 PvPrey - Player-controlled Horror
PvPrey is what people would call an "asymmetrical horror game" inspired by Dead By Daylight and others. You are able to choose between new and improved monsters from Munkie, Munkie: Explorers and Munkie: Deluxe. It follows the charming tradition of working together to power an escape route
